camel_example: aliyun hbr DeleteBackupPlan --region cn-hangzhou --PlanId 'plan-000000000000000000000' --SourceType ECS_FILE --VaultId 'v-000000000000000000000' --Edition STANDARD --RequireNoRunningJobs false
kebab_example: aliyun hbr delete-backup-plan --plan-id plan-000000000000000000000 --vault-id v-000000000000000000000 --source-type ECS_FILE --require-no-running-jobs false --edition STANDARD --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault. This parameter is required if the SourceType parameter is not set to UDM\_ECS
parameters.help_zh: 备份库仓库ID，当SourceType不为UDM_ECS时，备份仓库ID必填
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- **ECS\_FILE**: Backs up Elastic Compute Service (ECS) files.

- **OSS**: Backs up Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets.

- **NAS**: Backs up Network Attached Storage (NAS) file systems.

- **UDM\_ECS**: Backs up entire ECS instances.

- **OTS**: Backs up Tablestore instances
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：

- **ECS_FILE**：表示备份ECS文件
- **OSS**：表示备份阿里云OSS
- **NAS**：表示备份阿里云NAS
- **UDM_ECS**：表示备份ECS整机
- **OTS**：表示备份阿里云Tablestore
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to prevent the deletion of the backup plan if backup jobs are running
parameters.help_zh: 是否要求无正在运行的作业
parameters.name: require_no_running_jobs

parameters.help_en: The edition type. Valid values are BASIC and STANDARD. The default value is STANDARD
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型，支持BASIC和STANDARD，默认值为STANDARD
parameters.name: edition
